what: Tom's camera, one row a situation (his page of 28 October 2026, 19:02: "Between, nudged so his feet are fully in frame. Keep Mafia's idea of the camera changing by situation: closer for talk and low rooms, wider for fights so you see the other man's feet and the people watching."; Study 9, its item 2: the modes as rows of one spec, read by the existing arm). Metres and degrees: back along the arm from the pivot, aside (right), up, the pivot above his feet, the lens horizontal. Read by SliceCharacter.cpp at the start; -CamBackM and the rest still override it for pictures.
reference: Mafia: The Old Country, read from its files (production/research/aaa-reference/studies/09-camera-controls.md): on foot 1.65 back, 0.45 aside, 0.35 up from a pivot 1.25 m up, 82 degrees; town walking 1.55 and 79; running 1.40 and 85; low rooms 1.20, 0.35 aside, 78; talk with Tom 1.5 m from the speaker, 63 degrees. Ours before: 3.2 back, 0.45 aside, 0.55 up from the hip (0.88), 90.

street.why: His pick (his page, 19:02): the Between picture (2.4 m, 86 degrees, pivot 1.05, 0.45 up) with his feet fully in frame; his answer of 20:06: not by lowering the camera (0.08 up made him too big and blocked the street's far end) but by pulling back, the Between height kept, his head level with the far end. At that height the feet come fully in only from 3.0 m (11 px to spare) and 3.1 m (28 px), measured in the packaged game at 12 degrees down (28 October, pictures back-2.6 to back-3.1); 2.9 m still cuts the heels. So 3.1 m, shown to him on his page, and his pick there (29 October, 08:12: "3.1"; RULINGS.md).

to_come: fights (wider, so the other man's feet and the onlookers are seen; Mafia's fight layer only lowers its camera 15 cm, so no width found: to be measured from his framing), and Tom placed 1.5 m from a speaker; each a row here, each shown to him in the game before it is kept.

talk.hold_why: 29 October, the packaged camera film: held 2 s after the talk's last sign, the camera went in, out and in again, because the gap between his line and her voice is longer; a conversation is an exchange, so the row holds 6 s (ours; Mafia's hold was not read).
talk.why: Reference first: Mafia's talk camera, read from its files (Study 9): 63 degrees, the pivot 1.50 m up, 1.20 m back and 0.25 aside, eased in and out over 2 s; up 0.10 is ours (Mafia's talk lift was not read), putting the camera at 1.60 m, Mafia's own on-foot camera height (pivot 1.25 + 0.35). On while the say box is open, an answer is awaited or one is spoken, and 2 s after. Not yet: Mafia's placing the player 1.5 m from the speaker. To be shown to him in the game before it is kept (his ruling of 28 October: closer for talk).

run.why: Reference first: Mafia runs 0.85 of its walking distance (1.40 against 1.65 m) and 3 degrees wider (85 against 82), blended in 0.2 s (Study 9); applied to his street row as ratios (3.1 x 0.85 = 2.63 m; 86 + 3 = 89), since our street camera is not Mafia's. On while Tom runs (shift) faster than a walk. To be shown to him in the game before it is kept.

room.why: Reference first: Mafia's camera in low rooms, read from its files (Study 9): 1.20 m back, 0.35 aside, a 78-degree lens; its height and pivot not read, so the street's are kept (ours). Inside Mickey's office only, against the office's own 2.0 m arm (mickeys-office.json inside.arm_m). Used only with -RoomRow until he has seen it in the game (29 October); the office's own arm stays the default.
